SENSOR_SMOKE.means: capture machinery works; no comparability guarantee

UNPAIRED_CAPTURE.means: not a valid paired route claim: no route manifest, or any mandatory equality failed, or route not fully representable on both arms, or arm exception
UNPAIRED_CAPTURE.reasons_recorded: route_manifest_absent, pair_invalid_mandatory_equalities, PAIR_ROUTE_INVALID, manual/auto_arm_incomplete, spawn_shuffle/recovery_used, weather/rig/timing/config sha mismatch

PAIRED_PROTOCOL_VALID.means: all mandatory equalities hold and route is representable on both arms; identity of the two maps is not asserted as Ingolstadt

PAIRED_INGOLSTADT_CAPTURE.means: PAIRED_PROTOCOL_VALID and manual arm has Grid0821/Grid0828 manual-map identity AND auto arm XODR sha/path matches the Ingolstadt map-of-record

boundary_rules: Town10HD or any control arm can never be PAIRED_INGOLSTADT_CAPTURE
hidden spawn recovery in THESIS_PAIRED_STRICT fails the pair before any frame is compared
pair_valid is only ever true when ALL mandatory equalities hold AND route is valid
equalities are content digests: same spawn index, same preset name or same wall-clock are not identities

gate_artifacts.paired_capture_manifest.json: built by build_pair_manifest and re-validated by validate_pair_manifest before exit
gate_artifacts.arm completeness: completion_status from each arm's perception_status.json in strict mode

model_of_record_binding.manual: ultimate_pipeline/experiments/thesis/manual_refs.py -> MANUAL_INGOLSTADT_REFS (Grid0821, Grid0828) XODR sha256 + cooked town

live_validation_status: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL - claim-level end-to-end award requires a reachable simulator; offline tests pin the boundary logic
